purpose: Holds the three surfaces WUI-17 registered (reports/, knowledge-staging/, repository root) to the policy each one earned, so they can enter the reference gate without dumping 3,000 findings on the next writer. Grants no decision; the reference-resolution rule itself stays in scripts/ci/verify_authority_index_paths.py.

population.note: <root> means tracked markdown at the repository root (no slash in the path).

reclassifiedLive.breakdown: 93 in five NON-NORMATIVE-HISTORICAL root records, 6 in AGENTS.md's documented-absence statement, 44 across date-stamped reports

externalSkillCopies.reason: These files are inbound copies of other repositories' skills. Their sentences cite their own upstream tree, so a resolution attempt against THIS repository's tracked set is a category error, not a broken pointer. knowledge-staging/ is itself a frozen surface (FROZEN.md + FROZEN-MANIFEST.json), so the copy cannot be edited into compliance either.

ratchet.policy: The broken-reference count may not grow and every baseline row must still be broken today. Repairing a pointer is a real change and must reissue this baseline in the same commit; a one-sided ceiling would let a repair silently shrink what the baseline records.

groups.reason: date-stamped audit archive; frozen by FROZEN.md + FROZEN-MANIFEST.json. Rewriting a dated record makes it describe a tree it never saw.
date-stamped audit and delivery reports (2026-09-25 .. 2026-10-06) narrating other trees (Hermes Home, the external UI package). Editing one falsifies the record.

the five root records with broken references are disposition historical-non-normative and their bodies are byte-frozen by scripts/ci/verify_root_document_dispositions.py; AGENTS.md's six skills//bin/ citations are the sentence stating those repository-root directories do not exist, so rewriting them would erase the warning.
